question: Hardy shrubs and trees that thrive in salt water and have specialised adaptations so that they can survive the volatile energies of intertidal zones along marine coasts are characteristics of _________ forests.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mangrove**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mangrove** forests are unique ecosystems found in **coastal intertidal zones**.
 
• These forests consist of **hardy shrubs and trees** that thrive in saltwater environments.
 
• Mangroves have specialized adaptations, such as pneumatophores (breathing roots) and salt-filtering mechanisms, to survive the volatile energies of intertidal zones.
 
• They play a crucial role in protecting coastlines from erosion and provide habitat for a diverse range of marine and terrestrial species.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mangrove ecosystems** are found in **tropical and subtropical regions** around the world.
 
• They are highly productive and provide numerous ecosystem services, including carbon sequestration, water filtration, and serving as nurseries for fish and other aquatic organisms.
 
• Conservation of mangrove forests is essential for maintaining biodiversity and supporting the livelihoods of local communities who depend on these ecosystems for resources.
